main.description: A petri culture grown in the Anisota Lab's Petri studio and saved to the owner's collection. A culture is stored as its recipe rather than its pixels: a 'seed', the dish dimensions, and the ordered list of 'drops' (each an ingredient inoculated at a normalised point and at a given iteration). Because the Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion simulation is deterministic, replaying that recipe rebuilds the exact field. 'iterations' is how far the culture has grown; 'lastTickAt' lets a reopened culture advance proportionally to real time elapsed. A small PNG thumbnail is kept for display.

branch.description: Form tunable 'branching' (dense blob → open dendrites → veins), scaled 0..1000

drops.description: Ordered inoculations: each an ingredient placed at a normalised point at a given iteration

atIteration.description: Iteration count at which this drop was placed

ingredient.description: Ingredient id (bacillus, mold, yeast, pigment, agar, antibiotic)

r.description: Optional inoculation radius in grid cells (per-drop size variation). Absent means the default radius.

tint.description: Optional custom colony hue from the colour picker, scaled to 0..1000. Absent means the dropper's default colour.

image.description: A PNG data URL thumbnail of the culture

iterations.description: How many simulation iterations the culture has grown

lastTickAt.description: When the culture last advanced, used to grow it forward on reopen

palette.description: Colour palette id (agar, rose, amber, marine)

seed.description: PRNG seed the simulation was initialised with

thickness.description: Form tunable 'thickness' (fine veins → fat rivulets), scaled 0..1000
